services.name: On-Site Group Programs
services.desc: Interested in booking a program? Send a request to our education team via our booking form. A member of our team will be in touch within 3 business days. Please note submission of this form does not guarantee the booking. MoD staff will provide formal confirmation by email for any requested bookings. The MoD offers a range of on-site programs for children’s groups. Organizers can build their preferred schedule for a half day, full day or evening program by choosing from the activities below. services.name: Museum of Dufferin Summer Camps
services.desc: If you know a child that loves to get messy and be hands-on, this camp is for them! Learn all about the world of archaeology through hands-on digs, excavation, crafts and outdoor activities. On the final day of camp, they will host their very own exhibit of all of their findings! This immersive summer camp is perfect for campers who love all things myth, fantasy, and medieval lore. Step into a world of legendary heroes, epic quests, and ancient tales brought to life through games, creativity, and imagination. services.name: School Programs
services.desc: For this 90-minute program, Museum of Dufferin staff travel to your classroom! This program will lead students to explore several different winter celebrations and traditions. They will compare these traditions to find similarities between them, along with reflecting on their own celebrations. This program takes place onsite at the Museum of Dufferin. In this full day program, students will participate in interactive learning stations as they explore the history of Indigenous Peoples & Early Settlers in Dufferin County.
